summary: The held volatile-fixture probe observed that both a known transport_failure and an outcome_unknown from Registration.registerTeacher, released after controller navigation to /login, were rendered on the current login form as visible hh-status local-error feedback. The known-failure message exactly matched the same-route /register control. The outcome_unknown request status remained outcome_unknown and its message advised checking state before retrying, although the shared outcome/render class was local-error. A separate empty-login local-validation control rendered its own login feedback. Each registration case made exactly one provider registration call, had canRetry false, and showed no runtime registration/session change; generated passwords were absent from controller state, runtime snapshot/inspection, actual PxC Part values, storage and rendered tree. This is a reproducible shared-feedback behavior, not a declared defect: product intent for global feedback is unresolved. No product source or tests were changed.

phase_controls.known_same_register_route: Held transport_failure released while /register remained current; register form showed local-error with simulated transport-failure message; request failed, runtime registration none/session anonymous.
phase_controls.known_late_login: Held transport_failure released after controller navigation to /login; login form remained current and rendered the same shared local-error feedback.
phase_controls.unknown_late_login: Held outcome_unknown released after controller navigation to /login; login form remained current and rendered visible status with 'Check state before trying again.' Request status was outcome_unknown; shared outcome kind and rendered CSS class were local-error.
phase_controls.login_validation_control: Empty local login submission on /login rendered validation-error feedback; no registration-provider call.
phase_controls.write_and_retry_window: One registration provider invocation in each failure case; no second/automatic invocation observed before any explicit user action; canRetry false. No retry was attempted.
phase_controls.secret_scan: randomUUID passwords were checked only by boolean non-occurrence against controller state, runtime snapshot/inspection, runtime.pxc.entries() Part values, storage and rendered tree. All cases returned true. Synthetic example.test identity/domain values are non-secret and were intentionally present where expected; no claim that non-secret identity data was absent.
phase_controls.authority: Supported runtime fields were mode=fixture, fixture=true, productionAuthority=false; registration remained none and session anonymous. Authority beyond those supported fixture fields is UNKNOWN/not exercised.
